coverageNotes: Covers three literal-tagged branches and field correlation, shared with compound-types. Does not measure independently authoring a complete schema. Exact descriptors and argument-validation wrappers preserve the original schema.

questions.question: Which expression belongs inside `defineTable(...)`?

options.text:
```ts
v.union(
  v.object({ kind: v.literal("message"), ...message }),
  v.object({ kind: v.literal("friendRequest"), ...friendRequest }),
  v.object({ kind: v.literal("achievement"), ...achievement }),
)
```
options.rationale: Each literal tag is paired with exactly its own required payload fields.

options.text:
```ts
v.union(
  v.object({ kind: v.string(), ...message }),
  v.object({ kind: v.string(), ...friendRequest }),
  v.object({ kind: v.string(), ...achievement }),
)
```
options.rationale: String tags accept unknown tags and tags paired with another branch’s payload.

options.text:
```ts
v.object({
  kind: kinds,
  senderId: v.optional(v.string()), messageText: v.optional(v.string()),
  requesterId: v.optional(v.string()),
  achievementName: v.optional(v.string()), points: v.optional(v.number()),
})
```
options.rationale: Optional independent fields accept missing and mixed payloads.
This requires an extra payload object and does not model the flat union.
